context: A boss reviews a corporate issue
purpose: Teach: 問いかけ/たどっ/潰れ/壊さ/敷い/歪ん/聞き取れ/消さ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員への問いかけ、月一で実施しろ。
lines.style: Sharp, decisive. Brief breath-pause after the verb. Authority without drama. Eyes moving to the next task already.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。創業の道をたどった社史、丁寧に編集します。
lines.en: Understood. I'll edit the company history—the founding story—carefully.
lines.style: Attentive nod underlying the words. Steady pace, measured. Slight lean forward to show he's tracking the thread. Businesslike but not rushed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 倉庫の屋根、潰れた箇所、修理を急げ。
lines.en: The warehouse roof—damaged sections. Get the repairs done quickly.
lines.style: Clipped sentences. Weight on 'quickly.' No softening. This is a problem he wants solved, not discussed. Tone stays level and direct.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 設備を壊さずに、改修、進めます。
lines.en: Understood. We'll proceed carefully so equipment doesn't get damaged.
lines.style: Calm assurance. Not defensive—just laying out the plan. Quiet confidence that the work will be done right. Measured tempo, no hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: カーペット、新しく敷いたフロア、来客に好評だ。
lines.en: The new carpet on the floor—guests have been responding well to it.
lines.style: Slight shift to warmth here. Observational rather than directive. A beat of genuine noticing. Not praise exactly, but acknowledgment that something worked.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。報告書、歪んだ数値、修正しました。
lines.en: Yes. I've corrected the data issues in the reports.
lines.style: Efficient. Brief acknowledgment and handoff. Shows he understood the indirect request—that positive action includes attention to detail elsewhere.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 役員会、聞き取れない部分、議事録、補強しろ。
lines.en: The board meeting minutes—fill in the parts that were unclear on the recording.
lines.style: Direct instruction with clear purpose. No softness but not harsh. This is maintenance work, not blame. Even tempo, expects compliance without drama.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。痕跡、消さずに、改善履歴、残します。
lines.en: Understood. I'll strengthen the record while keeping a trail of what was added and why.
lines.style: Careful words. Slight emphasis on 'why'—showing he understands the ethical weight here. Deliberate, thoughtful pace. Not defensive, but thorough.
